notes.title: The 1st Hayfever Speedrun Competition!
notes.content:
The time has finally come!

Sixteen players will be joining the official Hayfever Speedrunning Tournament, hoping to win the $500 grand prize! 
To enter, simply sign up through [url=https://challonge.com/hayfever]Challonge[/url], then submit an Any% run at https://www.speedrun.com/hayfever by April 4th. 
The top 16 applicants on the leaderboard will be chosen to play.

For ease of communication, we ask that you have a Discord account and join the [url=https://discord.gg/kusogrande]Kusogrande Discord server[/url] ; all organization will happen there. Please send a PM to Brossentia asking to be added to the Hayfever competitor role.
In order to compete, players must be able to steam via Twitch. 

All players will receive prizes for participating (we're nice like that). 

Love / The Hayfever Gang <3

notes.title: Blind Hayfever Speedrun Exhibition 14th of March!
notes.content:
Atchoooooo! 
Hey guys, we have something really cool happening very soon! 
As a lead-up to the first Hayfever Speed-tournament, we're organizing a blind exhibition on March 14th. 
This means that four veteran speed runners, who have yet to play Hayfever, will compete against each other! They'll need to quickly master the gameplay to try and make it the furthest in the game, racing against both each other and the clock!
 
[b]The event will take place on March 14th, 10 p.m / 3p.m PST
[/b]
This awesome event will be hosted by Brossentia, a regular at the Games Done Quick charity speedrunning events.

You can tune in and watch the exhibition here: https://www.twitch.tv/brossentia
In the coming days we'll put out the official announcement for the first real Tournament, which will take place end of March / early April. 

Get hyped!

notes.title: Patch + Coming Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We recently pushed up a small patch which mostly fixes smaller bugs and issues. We will continue to patch the game along with the coming update.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

- Difficulty tweak on "Twinkie", and "Twinkie Hard".
- Fixed a sensitivity problem with Deadzone on Gamepad
- Smaller general bugs have been squashed

---

In addition to this, we're also at work on a coming update! This update will go live this month.

[b]The coming update will be including:[/b]
- Rebindable keys for keyboard
- A game timer
- General quality of life things, eg. turning off Rumble, etc.

I hope you'll be looking forward to the update!

- Conny
